description: This file contains test cases for the Angular project template using pytest. It includes fixtures for setting up temporary directories and mock templates, as well as tests for verifying template initialization info, project creation, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and template variable replacement.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for project parameters such as name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and additional parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different types of projects, e.g., Angular.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data structure holding initial template commands and environment info.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Fixture that creates and tears down a temporary directory for tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that sets up a mock Angular template directory with configuration and sample files.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a sample project configuration object.

methods.name: test_angular_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that verifies retrieval of initialization info from AngularTemplate.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that performs project initialization and checks the output directory and file contents.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Test that verifies the execution of post-processing scripts during project initialization.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Test that loads project configuration from a JSON file and verifies its content.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that verifies template variable substitution in output files.
